name: MoonshineStill
concept: The village moonshine still: an improvised home-built apple-spirit still set up in a yard, a dented aluminium milk-can pot on a brick firebox, a copper pipe running to a coil in a cooling barrel. Players load mash, work it and collect the spirit.
prompt: Improvised home-made moonshine still: a large dented aluminium pot with a clamped lid sitting on a low brick firebox, a short copper pipe leaving the lid and running down into a wooden cooling barrel with a copper coil, a small tap at the bottom of the barrel. no text, no logos.
